newsitem.title: UK: Ldn freight - Biggest BFI jump in 18 months.
newsitem.headline: Ldn freight - Biggest BFI jump in 18 months.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) shot to its biggest single daily increase for 18 months, up 40 points to 1433, a level last seen on May 15th.

The advance was broadly based with brokers divided about whether the Atlantic or Pacific has the greater potential for further gains. Vessels and cargoes are now being turned over and relet, especially by S Korean operators, at bewildering speed.

Brokers say, for example, that they hear talk that Silver Star 69,235 dwt was fixed earlier this week delivery Japan mid-Nov for 3-5 months at $10,500, then re-let shortly afterwards at $10,900 daily -- and is now re-let again for an Australian or NoPac round at $11,800 daily.

Exceptional conditions in the Atlantic have resulted in Katrina/CMT nominating a previously chartered vessel, Oriental Nova 70,189 dwt, for an end Nov US Gulf/Taiwan stem and also booking Anangel Omonia 73,519 dwt delivery Continent about Nov 18 for 12 months at $11,000 daily.

Caper rates continue to make relatively slow progress in the wake of the Panamaxes with a number of period fixtures on subjects, and geared tonnage is also beginning to to make a little headway in cetain areas.

The 1977-built Angeliki 126,579 dwt is the latest vessel rumoured fixed on subjects by Iranians, delivery Continent Nov trip via St Lawrence redelivery Iran at $9,750 daily. Among the Panamaxes Continental fixed and failed Oceanic Explorer 68,849 dwt delivery US Gulf mid Nov trip Far East at $13,750 daily plus $350,000 bonus but are believed to have been involved of the relet of Despina, possibly to Cho Yang, for a mid Nov stem of 54,000 HSS US Gulf/Japan at $24.50 no combo, up 25 cents from the fixture by Dreyfus Wednesday of Rialto for end Nov.

Cobelfret were thought to be working a Panamax grain stem US Gulf/Continent but details were lacking. Timecharter rates once again dominated the day's biness. Galene 73,650 dwt was fixed by d'Amato for 2 laden legs delivery Algeciras mid Nov, possibly with a Kamsar/PT Comfort first cargo followed by grain, redelivery Far East at a strong $14,750 daily.

Torm Tekla 69,268 dwt was reported to have achieved the same level delivery Morocco mid Nov for a straight trip via US Gulf to the Far East. In the Handies Nidera were said to have fixed Sir Michael for 15,000 grains 57' plate/2 ports Cape Town-Durban range at $27.75 basis 1-2 and a cargo of 25,800 grains 53' was said to have been fixed Portland/China at an undisclosed rate.

Caper rates showed some further positive signs for owners, not least Cetragpa's fixture of Comanche for 120,000 coal Roads/Fos for end Nov at $6.50. Klaveness were said to have covered about 115,000 ironore Tubarao/Dunkirk East at just below $8.00. Cape Cathay 149,433 dwt was rumoured fixed in the East. But the real action was with the Panamaxes in the Far East. K Line were on subjects Oceanic Glory 69,235 dwt delivery Taiwan Nov 20/25 trip via E Australia to Japan at $13,000 daily, CSK Fortune 65,622 dwt was said to be working 3-5 months closely with S Korean charterers at a high level, and a modern Panamax was fixed from the Far East to the Continent at $8,250 daily, possibly account Aimcor.

Atlantic Sovereign 65,000 dwt open Japan Nov 10/15 was said to be holding charterers firm for a trip Skaw-Passero at over $9,000 daily. Pan Ocean were linked with Docelotus 75,594 dwt for coal business from S Africa to the Continent and were said to have booked Crystal Grace 64,975 dwt delivery Bin Qasim for 3-5 months at $10,300 daily. Samsun fixed the 1978-built Lia 69,447 dwt delivery Muscat nov 20/25 trip via S Africa to the Continent at $6,500 daily. Fertilizer business was fixed by Anthia 81,798 dwt from Black Sea to the Middle East on timecharter on private terms. There were reports of 40,000 tonnes urea fixed Jubail/Mississippi at $15.00.

Taxiarhis P 39,013 dwt was booked for a transatlantic voyage from Morocco and Faethon 45,000 dwt was rumoured relet by Star delivery spot Canakkale trip via Black Sea to Bangkok with Pan Ocean at $14,000 daily. Yenisei 37,000 dwt was taken for a similar trip by the same charterers at $10,000 daily. In the Pacific Olympic Miracle 29,000 dwt obtained a firmer $7,000 daily plus $130,000 bonus from Pan Ocean delivery NoPac end Nov for a trip to the Far East. Danah 23,618 dwt was fixed on subject by Granco delivery Hongkong Nov 17 trip Caribbean at $5,700 daily.
